visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of a red and white Nike sneaker resting on a white circular marble table. The camera slowly pans across the shoe, highlighting the intricate red texture overlays and the white mesh base. (2) A young man with brown hair, wearing a black long-sleeved sweatshirt, appears in the frame holding the shoes. He smiles at the camera and uses his index finger to point out the ribbed patterns on the side of the sneaker. (3) A split-screen or graphic transition displays an image of the Colossal Titan from the anime 'Attack on Titan', followed by a standard white Nike Zoom Vomero 5 product shot for visual comparison. (4) The camera zooms in on the man's hands as he manipulates the shoe to show the bottom sole. The sole features segmented black and white rubber pieces that resemble teeth. (5) Close-up shots focus on the specific red fabric sections of the shoe, which have a velvet-like texture. The man's fingers are seen gently pressing and rubbing the material to demonstrate its softness. (6) A still photograph is overlaid showing the man wearing the sneakers as part of an outfit consisting of a black beanie and black wide-leg trousers. Another image shows a person in a full-body muscle-patterned suit. (7) The man continues talking to the camera in a brightly lit indoor studio setting, holding the shoes near his face and pointing towards the back heel design before the video ends.

(5) [Subtitle]: 把它應用得跟進擊的巨人真的很像. 像是這個地方的紋路. (6) [Variety]: (詞彙量: 有待加強). [Subtitle]: 這個地方的這種. 我覺得最關鍵是這個牙齒. (7) [Subtitle]: 真的超級像牙齒. 這真的一顆一顆的. 它使用的是一個絨布的材質. (8) [Variety]: (捏).
